fields.cover_headline: Same card. Same price. Only one got {o:views}.
fields.cover_sub: Why a copy of your old post gets ignored.
fields.step1_heading: I tested it on my own {b:store}
fields.step1_body:
I sell postcards on eBay.
"Sell similar" copies
an old listing.
A fresh listing starts
from zero.
Same cards. Two ways to list.
fields.step2_body:
The copies sat still.
The fresh ones got shown.
Same card. Same price.
So what does that mean
for your app?
fields.step3_body:
Reposting it word for word
is "sell similar"
for your app.
Give the feed something new.
Every single time.
fields.step4_body:
One buyer question per post.
One new detail each time.
A fix, a number,
a user's words.
The product stays.
The angle moves.
fields.cta_headline: You keep reposting. It keeps sinking.
fields.cta_subtext: Follow for more tests from my own store and my own app.
